## Scientific packages

### `oceancube`

**R package · Stable source release · R**

Validated R infrastructure for representing, inspecting, subsetting, extracting, visualizing, and transforming multidimensional ocean data cubes for reproducible marine analysis.

[Project page](/software/oceancube/) · [Repository](https://github.com/qselmer/oceancube)

## Experimental applications

### `humboldt-ocean-watch`

**Experimental application · Experimental · Python**

Python and Streamlit system for reproducible thermal monitoring of Niño 1+2 using validated local analytics, quality control, event diagnostics, and optional grounded scientific briefs.

[Project page](/software/humboldt-ocean-watch/) · [Repository](https://github.com/qselmer/humboldt-ocean-watch)
